description: eSoul Laravel base on top of the upstream skeleton: app/{Domain,Application,Infrastructure} layering (service providers in App\Domain\Providers, Eloquent models in App\Infrastructure\Models, controllers in App\Infrastructure\Http\Controllers), esoul-cz/laravel-cqrs (commands and queries under App\Domain\CQRS), a layer architecture test (tests/Unit/Architecture), Pint, Larastan level 10 with bleedingEdge, PHPUnit 13 + paratest, Infection, php-fpm production image (RUN_MIGRATIONS/RUN_SCHEDULER/RUN_QUEUE_WORKER; its healthcheck checks Supervisor and a FastCGI request for /up) and dev docker-compose (php-fpm, nginx on APP_PORT 8080, MariaDB 12.3 like production, Mailpit), one-call Jenkinsfile (laravelPipeline), an operations README, TRUSTED_PROXIES wired through a project TrustProxies middleware (config/proxy.php), the Money value object (App\Domain\ValueObjects\Money, Currency, MoneyFormatter; App\Infrastructure\Casts\MoneyCast, see README.md of this layer), OTEL_* placeholders and a hardened pnpm-workspace.yaml. bootstrap/providers.php lists AppServiceProvider only: a layer that adds a provider overwrites it, and the LAST layer in a variant owns the full list.
